name: plottwist-embedder-ft
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Contrastive finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (MultipleNegativesRankingLoss, scale 20, 2,400 pitch->logline pairs, 2 epochs, batch 32, lr 5e-5) for movie pitch-to-logline retrieval over a 10k synthetic catalog. Genuine same-table base comparison: base 0.753 / fine-tuned 0.845 at recall@1 on a held-out 600-pitch test set, and the card ships eval_recall_base_vs_ft.json with those numbers plus the FAISS index. The evaluation is explicitly non-circular - the authors replaced v1's genre-consistency metric, which was computed on data generated conditioned on genre. It is a private synthetic catalog, not BEIR or MTEB, so these numbers are not comparable to BEIR nDCG@10 elsewhere in this catalog. 768 output dims, 109M params. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-08.

benchmarks.name: Pitch-to-logline recall@1
benchmarks.config: Card table '| metric | base | fine-tuned |': all-mpnet-base-v2 0.753 vs fine-tuned 0.845. Held-out test = 600 pitches, catalog = 10k loglines, train/test 2400/600, FAISS IndexFlatIP on L2-normalised embeddings. Non-circular: pitches are LLM-written for held-out loglines, replacing v1's circular genre-consistency metric.
